back: A marker a transaction holds on data to control others' access until it ends.
Shared: many readers, no writers. Exclusive: one holder only.
Lock before reading for update (SELECT … FOR UPDATE); others wait.
NOWAIT errors if locked; SKIP LOCKED skips locked rows.
1 second ÷ lock hold time, e.g. 5 ms → 200/s.
Split into bucket rows or use an atomic conditional UPDATE.
No lock on read; UPDATE … WHERE version = read_version; 0 rows means conflict.
Rare conflicts and long user think-time.
Two transactions each hold a lock the other needs, so both wait forever.
Consistent lock order, short transactions, lock all at once, retry on error.
A lock that expires automatically if the holder stops renewing it.
An increasing number checked by storage so stale lock holders can't write.
